description: Search Michelin-starred restaurants, filter by city or star rating, or scrape individual restaurant pages from guide.michelin.com.

city.description: City name to browse restaurants in (mode=byCity), e.g. `Paris`, `Tokyo`, `New York`.
city.title: City

country.description: Filter by country slug used in Michelin Guide URLs. Use lowercase slug format (e.g. 'france', 'japan', 'united-states'). The value is automatically normalized to lowercase if entered manually.
country.title: Country

cuisineFilter.description: Filter by cuisine type. Note: 'Classic Cuisine' and 'Traditional Cuisine' are how Michelin labels most French/regional cuisine in France — use those options to find French cuisine restaurants in Paris, Lyon, etc. 'French' matches restaurants explicitly labeled 'French' by Michelin, which is more common outside France.
cuisineFilter.title: Cuisine filter

includeDetails.description: If enabled, the scraper visits each individual restaurant page for additional data (phone, website, geo-coordinates, opening hours, full description). Note: detail pages may be rate-limited or blocked in some regions; listing data is always scraped regardless of this setting.
includeDetails.title: Fetch restaurant detail pages

maxItems.description: Maximum number of restaurant records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch from the Michelin Guide.
enumTitles: Search restaurants by name or keyword
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. AUTO datacenter proxy is used by default for Michelin Guide bot-detection bypass.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Restaurant name or keyword to search for (mode=search).
searchQuery.title: Search query

starFilter.description: Filter restaurants by Michelin distinction (applies to all modes).
starFilter.title: Star / distinction filter

startUrls.description: List of Michelin Guide restaurant page URLs to scrape (mode=byUrl). Each item must have a `url` key, e.g. `https://guide.michelin.com/en/ile-de-france/paris/restaurant/guy-savoy`.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (mode=byUrl)

title: Michelin Guide Scraper Input
